_comment: Token prices, per million tokens, used by the L9 cost lab.
These are NOT verified. Provider pricing changes, and a stale table
produces confident wrong numbers, which is worse than no numbers at all.
The loader prints a warning on every run while 'verified' is false.
To verify: check the provider's current pricing page, update the values,
set verified to true, and set checked_on to today. The cost lab reports
that date alongside every figure so nobody reads a number without knowing

gpt-4.1-mini.note: Default for corpus generation. Chosen deliberately: see below.

_corpus_model_rationale: The corpus is generated with a mid-tier model on purpose, and the reason
is pedagogical before it is financial.
A frontier model handles most of these support cases correctly. A corpus
where the agent rarely fails gives Module 2 almost nothing to find, and
error analysis on a near-perfect trace set teaches the wrong lesson: that
the method is not worth the effort.
A mid-tier model fails at a rate that makes the failure modes in SPEC.md
section 7 actually appear, at a density where saturation is reachable in
the 60 traces the L5 homework asks for. It is also cheaper, which is a
convenient second-order benefit rather than the reason.
